# Held-out exercises for external-integration. The request names the happy path or one
# symptom, and PROVIDER.md says how the service behaves around it.

# PROVIDER.md says delivery is at least once, for up to three days, across restarts. The
# verifier redelivers, restarts the process and takes the ledger down.
[webhook-redelivery] credit the account when an invoice.paid event arrives: add it to handlers.handle_event | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# PROVIDER.md says a refresh token works once and reusing it revokes the grant. The
# verifier runs the export three times in new processes, then answers 401 for good.
[token-rotation] the nightly export dies with a 401 after an hour, make the CRM client refresh its token | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
